name: Costco Deli Prepared Cavatappi Mac & Cheese, Chicken Pot Pie & Meatloaf with Mash
brandOrRestaurant: Costco Fresh Deli (North Logan, Draper, South Jordan & Nationwide)
groceryIngredients: Costco Deli Meatloaf & Yukon Gold Mashed Potatoes tray
whyItWorks: Costco's take-and-bake Meatloaf with Yukon Gold Mashed Potatoes and Cavatappi Mac & Cheese are soft, zero-seed family trays that reheat effortlessly.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake the Meatloaf & Mashed Potatoes or Mac & Cheese tray in the oven and pair with a Lactaid; if buying the Chicken Street Tacos kit, warm the chicken in flour tortillas and skip the lime wedges and cabbage slaw.
watchOuts: Skip the raw cabbage slaw, salsa, and lime wedges in the Costco Street Taco kit
Take a Lactaid for the rich cream/cheese in the Mac & Cheese and Mashed Potatoes
